document_api_meta.title: Create or Update Inbound Plan
document_api_meta.env_desc:
Creates a new inbound plan or fully replaces the contents of an existing inbound plan by using a goods item list or carton configurations with dimensions. Omit `plan_id` to create a plan; provide it to update one. Provide exactly one non-empty array: `goods_items` or `cartons`; do not provide both.

For an update, submit the complete desired goods or carton contents; previously stored goods or cartons omitted from the request are not retained. Using `goods_items` clears existing carton and lot/expiration data. Using `cartons` rebuilds the carton and item data.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: plan_id
request_body_param.desc: Without plan id it is creating, with plan id it is updating.

request_body_param.name: idempotent_key
request_body_param.desc: Idempotency key for creating an inbound plan. Required when `plan_id` is not provided.

request_body_param.name: goods_items
request_body_param.desc: Goods item list.

request_body_param.name: ^goods_id
request_body_param.desc: The Fulfilled by TikTok goods identifier for this inbound plan item. The goods must belong to the merchant associated with the authenticated seller, be approved for fulfillment, and be matched to an SKU.

request_body_param.name: ^quantity
request_body_param.desc: Quantity of this goods item in the inbound plan. Must be greater than 0.

request_body_param.name: cartons
request_body_param.desc: Carton List.

request_body_param.name: ^carton_type
request_body_param.desc:
Indicates whether the carton is configured as single-SKU or multi-SKU.

**Possible values:**
* `SINGLE_SKU`: `items` must contain exactly one item.
* `MULTI_SKU`: `items` must contain two or more items.

request_body_param.name: ^items
request_body_param.desc: Goods item list of a carton.

request_body_param.name: ^^goods_id
request_body_param.desc: The Fulfilled by TikTok goods identifier for this carton item. The goods must belong to the merchant associated with the authenticated seller, be approved for fulfillment, and be matched to an SKU.

request_body_param.name: ^^quantity
request_body_param.desc: Quantity of this goods item in each carton. Must be greater than 0.

request_body_param.name: ^^lot_code
request_body_param.desc: Lot code for this goods item. Required when lot-code management is enabled for the goods. Every occurrence of the same `goods_id` in `cartons` must use the same `lot_code` and `expiration_timestamp` values.

request_body_param.name: ^^expiration_timestamp
request_body_param.desc: The expiration date for this item, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Required when expiration management is enabled for the goods. It must be no earlier than the current time plus the goods-specific `inbound_cutoff_days`. Obtain this value from `data.goods[].lot_expiration_info.inbound_cutoff_days` in Search Goods Info (`POST /fbt/202607/goods/search`).

request_body_param.name: ^quantity
request_body_param.desc: Number of cartons that use this carton configuration.

request_body_param.name: ^carton_nums
request_body_param.desc: Identifiers assigned to the cartons represented by this configuration. Either every carton configuration in the request must provide a non-empty `carton_nums` array, or no configuration may provide any carton identifiers. When provided, the number of identifiers must equal this configuration's `quantity`; each identifier must use the format `C` followed by four digits and must be unique across the request. If none are provided, carton identifiers are generated automatically.

request_body_param.name: ^box_measurements
request_body_param.desc: Carton measurement.

request_body_param.name: ^^weight
request_body_param.desc: Carton weight.

request_body_param.name: ^^weight_unit
request_body_param.desc:
The unit used for the carton's `weight` value.

**Possible values:**
* `KILOGRAM` (kg)
* `GRAM` (g)
* `MILLIGRAM` (mg)
* `POUNDS` (lbs)
* `OUNCE` (oz)

request_body_param.name: ^^width
request_body_param.desc: Carton width.

request_body_param.name: ^^height
request_body_param.desc: Carton height.

request_body_param.name: ^^length
request_body_param.desc: Carton length.

request_body_param.name: ^^length_unit
request_body_param.desc:
The unit used for the carton's `length`, `width`, and `height` values.

**Possible values:**
* `METER` (m)
* `CENTIMETER` (cm)
* `MILLIMETER` (mm)
* `FOOT` (ft)
* `MICRON` (μm)
* `INCH` (in)

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
